model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата илюстрира сравнението на перплекситета при различни стойности на разреденост (sparsity rate), измерен в проценти, за два метода: „Per-Output“ и „Per-Layer“. Хоризонталната ос представлява разредеността, измерена в проценти, и включва стойности от 10% до 80%, разположени във възходящ ред. Вертикалната ос, означена като „Perplexity“, е логаритмична скала, която показва стойности от 10 до 1000, съответно 10¹ до 10³. За всяка стойност на разреденост са представени два стълба – син със съответстващия етикет „Per-Output“ и оранжев с етикет „Per-Layer“ – които визуализират перплекситета за съответните методи. Стълбовете са групирани по всеки процентен показател на разреденост, като за всеки процент са показани стойности за двата метода. Визуално се забелязва, че стойностите на перплекситета са по-ниски при по-ниски стойности на разредеността и нарастват с увеличаване на разредеността, като при 80% разреденост стойностите на перплекситета са най-високи и са почти еднакви за двата метода.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart displays the perplexity values for two different methods, "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer," across various sparsity rates ranging from 10% to 80%. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, with categories labeled as 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70%, and 80%, arranged in ascending order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Perplexity," uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. The chart consists of grouped bars for each sparsity rate, with the blue bar representing "Per-Output" and the orange bar representing "Per-Layer." For all sparsity rates, the "Per-Layer" method (orange bars) consistently exhibits a higher perplexity than the "Per-Output" method (blue bars). The perplexity for both methods generally increases with the sparsity rate. At 10% sparsity, the "Per-Output" perplexity is approximately 80, and the "Per-Layer" perplexity is approximately 60. At 80% sparsity, the "Per-Output" perplexity reaches approximately 1100, while the "Per-Layer" perplexity is slightly higher, at approximately 1200. The bars are arranged in groups, with the "Per-Output" bar positioned to the left of the "Per-Layer" bar within each group, and the groups are ordered by increasing sparsity rate. There are no visual emphases such as shading or outlines applied to any of the bars.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between perplexity and sparsity rate for two different methods, labeled "Per-Output" (blue bars) and "Per-Layer" (orange bars). The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, ranging from 10% to 80% in 10% increments, while the vertical axis, labeled "Perplexity," is displayed on a logarithmic scale from $10^1$ to $10^3$. For each sparsity rate, two bars are shown, with the "Per-Output" method consistently exhibiting lower perplexity than the "Per-Layer" method. As the sparsity rate increases, the perplexity for both methods generally increases, with a particularly sharp rise in perplexity for both methods at the 80% sparsity rate, where the "Per-Output" method reaches a perplexity of approximately 800 and the "Per-Layer" method reaches approximately 900.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm stellt die Perplexität in Abhängigkeit von verschiedenen Sparsitätsraten dar, wobei die Werte für zwei verschiedene Berechnungsmethoden, „Per-Output“ und „Per-Layer“, verglichen werden. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Sparsitätsrate in Prozent, mit Markierungen bei 10%, 20%, 30%, 40%, 50%, 60%, 70% und 80%. Die vertikale Achse zeigt die Perplexität auf einer logarithmischen Skala, die Werte von 10 bis 10³ umfasst. Für jede Sparsitätsrate sind zwei Balken dargestellt: ein blauer Balken für die „Per-Output“-Methode und ein orangefarbener Balken für die „Per-Layer“-Methode. Die Balken sind gruppiert, wobei die beiden Balken pro Sparsitätsrate nebeneinander angeordnet sind. Die Länge der Balken variiert mit der Sparsitätsrate, wobei die Balken für die „Per-Output“-Methode (blau) in der Regel länger sind als die für die „Per-Layer“-Methode (orange) bei denselben Sparsitätsraten. Die Balken sind in der Reihenfolge der Sparsitätsraten von links nach rechts angeordnet. Es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck, und die Beschriftungen der Balken sind durch die Legende und die Achsenbeschriftung klar identifizierbar.
